query: One of our Phaseo calls cost way more than I expected. The x-request-id header was G-01JZ0000000000000000000000. Why did it cost that much?
expected_behavior: Looks up the request by ID with phaseo:log_get, phaseo logs get --json or GET /v1/logs/{requestId}
Explains cost from cost_nanos (USD x 10^9), usage and pricing_lines
Compares requested_model_id with routed_model_id and provider, and checks byok
Offers to reprice with phaseo:cost_estimate or POST /v1/pricing/calculate
Does not print replay_request, prompts or outputs

query: Write a script that reports last week's Phaseo spend per API key and per model for our finance team.
expected_behavior: Uses the grouped rows from GET /v1/analytics (or /v1/analytics/export for CSV), filtered by key_id where needed, instead of paging logs or activity and summing individual requests client-side
Authenticates with a management API key that has analytics:read, read from an environment variable, not PHASEO_API_KEY
Notes that analytics usage values are USD and cover the last 30 completed UTC days
Contains no hard-coded secrets

query: Our app started getting 429 key_limit_exceeded from Phaseo with no Retry-After header. Should I just add retries?
expected_behavior: Explains that key_limit_exceeded without Retry-After will not reset by itself, so retrying does not help
Checks the key's limit, limit_remaining and usage windows with GET /v1/key or the workspace budgets with GET /v1/budgets
Points changes to key limits or budgets to the phaseo-guardrails skill
Distinguishes this from customer_requests_per_minute and rate_limit_exceeded, which do carry Retry-After

query: Using the Phaseo MCP, how many credits do I have left and what did I spend on yesterday?
expected_behavior: Calls phaseo:credits_get and reports available versus reserved balance
Calls phaseo:analytics_get with yesterday's UTC date and summarises cost by model and provider
Does not invent tool parameters beyond the tool's input schema
Summarises instead of dumping raw records

query: We want to see Phaseo cost per product feature and per customer going forward. What should we send on each request?
expected_behavior: Recommends X-Phaseo-Metadata labels and slicing with label_key and label_value in GET /v1/analytics
Recommends an end-user ID in the user field or X-Phaseo-User-Id and filtering analytics with end_user_id
Mentions X-App-Id for per-application grouping
Warns against putting emails, names, secrets or prompt text in labels or IDs

query: Which Phaseo model is the cheapest for summarising long documents with a 200k context window?
expected_behavior: Defers to phaseo-model-selection for choosing models by price, context and capability

query: Set up a guardrail so our staging API key can only use two providers and blocks prompt injection.
expected_behavior: Defers to phaseo-guardrails for key restrictions and guardrail configuration
